answer_1.quote: FLUID QA situates figurative expression selection within multi-turn conversational contexts, testing whether LLMs can make pragmatically appropriate choices across English, Korean, and Chinese.
answer_1.outputs: multi-turn dialogues with cloze-style prompts for figurative expression selection

answer_2.quote: We report macro F1 scores for both benchmarks, broken down by language (EN, ZH, KO) and model type.

answer_4.quote: For each target language (Korean and Chinese), native speakers participated in the evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: native speakers evaluated pairwise preference comparisons between literal translations and culturally adapted versions using the Bradley-Terry model
